notes: The default entries are from the BS in Computer Science (Duffield College of Engineering); the BA in Arts and Sciences has a different requirement list and was not used. CS 3110 (Functional Programming and Data Structures) is also required after CS 2110. The Cornell-wide rule is that AI use is set by each instructor, so the course-level policies above differ substantially (CS 1110 bans AI help on assignments and in discussion; CS 2110 and CS 4820 permit it with disclosure).
